name: loose-rein-kit-frontend
description: Build and test tooling for the rein dashboard's frontend. Nothing here is installed by a user of the CLI: `rein` is a Python package with three runtime dependencies, and `rein ui` serves the pre-built bundle in src/rein/ui_assets/ over the standard library. react and react-dom are `dependencies` because they end up inside that bundle; everything under devDependencies exists only to build, lint and test it.
